title: Improvement of conference hall at Deep Bhavan, Mumbai
summary: Percentage-rate two-cover e-tender for interior improvement and modification of the conference hall at Deep Bhavan, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai: acoustic doors, POP ceiling, teak wall panelling and veneer, motorised curtains, a large conference table with connectivity boxes, chairs and pantry storage.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai - 400 077
sites.work: Improvement and modification of conference hall (area 73.70 sqm per drawing)

scope.item: Dismantling granite frames of old windows including making good the surface
Dismantling unserviceable wooden/steel doors, windows, ventilators, cupboards (area 3 sqm and below)
Brick work with common burnt clay FPS bricks class 7.5 in CM 1:4
18 mm cement plaster in two coats (12 mm 1:5 + 6 mm 1:3)
White cement based putty 1 mm over plastered wall
Entry door - soundproof 50 mm second class teak wood shutter 6'x3', acoustic vinyl/polyester finish, switchable vision panel, hydraulic closer
10 mm plaster of Paris ceiling on GI/wood framework: flat surface 72 sqm; curved surfaces 36 sqm; extra for mouldings 18 sqm
Wall panelling: second class teak wood frame work
Wall panelling: 35 mm shutters with 12 mm teak wood panels
Natural wood finish veneer on wall panelling (two tones)
12 mm marine plywood panelling (IS 710)
Second class teak wood panelling 25-40 mm
Motorized curtains, remote/wifi operated, blackout fabric (80% polyester 20% cotton, 270 GSM, NFPA 701)
Conference table: second class teak wood frame work
Conference table: 12 mm particle board panelling (IS 3087)
Conference table: 9 mm particle board panelling (IS 1328 BWR)
Conference table top: laminated veneer lumber glazed shutter (IS 14616) with 4 mm float glass, 30 mm
Beading: 38x5 mm wooden 19 rmt; 18x10 mm wooden 66 rmt; 10x10 mm steel box 27 rmt
Natural wood finish veneer on conference table top (two tones)
Conference table connectivity box with 3 power sockets and 2 USB (18 W A+C), concealed
High back office chair (Godrej Interio or Durian class, synchro mechanism)
Medium back office chair (Godrej Interio or Durian class)
Modular kitchen cabinet 120 cm wide (Madesa or similar) for pantry
Adjustable height movable metal TV trolley for 32-70 inch TVs (Store2508 or similar)

money.performance_security: Performance guarantee 5% of contract value (FDR or BG) before work order; plus security deposit 5% deducted from each RA bill, released after 12 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost Rs 32,03,287 inclusive of GST (BOQ total 3203287.10). EMD by A/C payee DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months; original by 21/08/2025 16:00. MSME/NSIC bidders must also pay EMD. Quantity variation +/-25% at quoted rate. Water and electricity from department recovered at 1% + 1% of tender cost.

period.completion: 02 Months from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of Technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central/State Govt/Municipal Corporation etc. with tender limits equal to or above the estimated cost

Similar works (interior decoration/civil works in Central/State/PSU) completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% (Rs 12.81 lakh), or two >= 60% (Rs 19.22 lakh), or one >= 80% (Rs 25.62 lakh); completion certificates from Executive Engineer rank or above; sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost for last three financial years (stated as Rs 12,13,978)
PAN, GST registration, income tax returns for 2021-22 to 2023-24, P&L/auditor's reports

Tender acceptance letter (Annexure III), unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure IV), bid securing declaration (Annexure V), notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, no-relatives declaration (Annexure VIII)

Technical evaluation minimum 70/100: statutory documents 30 (includes consent/MoU with a B.Arch interior designer), financial standing 20, similar work experience 20, client performance certificates 20, key personnel 10 (1 graduate engineer, 2 diploma engineers)
specs: Soundproof doors: 50 mm second class teak wood, acoustic non-woven polyester 890 g/m2, fire rating C s3 d0/M1, switchable glass vision panel, 2-speed hydraulic closer max 14 Nm
Motorized curtains: smart wifi motor (Alexa/Google Home), blackout fabric 270 GSM, ISO 105-B02/X12/C06 colour fastness, NFPA 701
Conference table approx. 7.61 m x 1.80 m with 11 concealed connectivity boxes (drawing MUM/495/2025)
Glass door with 10 mm glass with switchable film in 100x230 mm second class teak frame (drawing MUM/497/2025)

unreadable: Pages 67-70 are drawings (existing plan MUM/493/2025, proposed plan MUM/494/2025, conference table MUM/495/2025, door MUM/497/2025), viewed but not transcribed in detail

notes: Listing title 'Renovation of Conference Hall at Deep Bhawan, Mumbai' differs from document ('Improvement of conference hall' / 'Improvement and modification of conference hall'). NIT dated 04 August 2025; download/submission 05/08/2025 16:00 to 19/08/2025 16:00; pre-bid 12/08/2025 16:00 at Deep Bhavan; technical bid opening 22/08/2025 16:00 (listing end date 2025-08-22 is the opening date). Internal inconsistencies: EMD figure Rs 64,100 but words say 'Eighty-One Thousand Rupees'; stated turnover figure Rs 12,13,978 is not 30% of the estimated cost (which would be about Rs 9.61 lakh); turnover years given as ending 31/03/2024 and 31/03/2025 in different clauses; NIT refers to eligibility 'clause 3.1' and evaluation refers to 'clause 3.1.2 (iii)', which is not present. BOQ items name brands (Godrej Interio/Durian, Madesa, Store2508, Desertcraft). Hindi duplicates, ITB, GCC, labour/safety rules and general civil specifications (pages 3-5, 9-43) are standard boilerplate, skimmed. Drawing no. MUM/496/2025 absent from the sequence. Named draughtsperson on drawings omitted.
